source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/README.md §0.3 'Tab rows (account, settings) span the frame above the two-column grid'; 'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' p14/p15's tab-row block (identical on both, only the active tab differs)
notes: TabRow.tsx is pure inline style (no Tailwind classes); every property here is a real product value.

The artboard gives the ACTIVE tab a solid 2px underline in the brand colour (`border-bottom:2px solid #5A5552`) and every RESTING tab a 2px TRANSPARENT underline of the same weight (so no tab shifts when its state changes) — margin-bottom -1px pulls that underline onto the container's own 1px hairline. TabRow.tsx renders no per-tab border at all (only weight/colour distinguish active vs resting) — its own header comment states this is deliberate ('matches the artboards, which show only weight/colour distinguishing the active tab'), which this measurement shows is incorrect: the artboard underlines the active tab.
